items.title: Developers can now access SageMaker Studio through the new AWS experience
items.summary: New Amazon SageMaker AI customers can now land in a fully configured SageMaker Studio environment in only a few steps. Sign up with an identity you already have, such as Amazon, Apple, GitHub, or Google, with no advanced AWS account or credit card required for most customers, plus $100 in AWS Free Tier credits.
items.creator: Hazim Qudah
